{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the marriage and family therapy master’s program at the T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics. Please review the highly detailed Program Handbook at: program handbook for information on the program courses, policies, procedures, timelines and more.
The yearly application deadline for this program is January 15th but may be extended depending on applications. Find out more about the admissions procedures.
Once you have reviewed the handbook, please email me with any questions you may have.
Submit an application today.
Thank you and we look forward to hearing from you!
Gina Perez Graduate Programs Coordinator T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics 480-965-6874
